_help: Copy this file into a new folder under episodes/, next to master.wav and the cousins' clips. Delete lines you don't need.
_follow_tolerance_help: seconds the animation may drift from her singing before it is re-synced. Smaller = follows her more closely, larger = smoother
_follow_lag_help: seconds. More negative = animation earlier, closer to 0 or positive = later. Try steps of 0.05 to 0.1
_style_options: staircase, karaoke, bignote, falling, pitchtrail, gauge, pads, arcs
_intro_title_help: each item is one line of the opening title. Use one item for a single line
_intro_theme_options: gold, purple, silver, rosegold, emerald, ice, crimson
_note: Kalyani version of ep03: her Mayamalavagowla recording with R, M and D moved up one semitone (tools/change_raga.py).
